purpose: Qualify a cancellation-resistant direct mapping from representable normalized water state S to the Ross face-table coordinate u=log10(-h/cm) for the C2B H_ENPR/SvG2006 closure over the existing bounded face envelope h=[-10000,-1] cm, without requiring a general runtime theta-to-head reconstruction.
relationship_to_failed_inverse_gate: F-ROSS01_GATE_C2B_HENPR_STATE_INVERSE_RESULT.json failed the stronger raw theta-to-head requirement near saturation. Ross2011 runtime face lookup does not require that stronger contract, so this is a separate coordinate qualification rather than a threshold relaxation.

canonical_numerical_retention_form.rationale: The SWAP source formulas are mathematically constructed to match value and derivative at h105. Direct source arithmetic leaves an approximately 1e-12 normalized floating seam. V1N evaluates algebraically equivalent join coefficients in a form that enforces the intended C0 join exactly in binary64.
definitions: C105=dtheta/dh of the normalized dry branch at h105
canonical_numerical_retention_form.source_equivalence_check: The stabilized normalized S(h) must remain within 2e-12 of the direct source arithmetic over the frozen head envelope for every material.

candidate_mapping.domain_rule: Representable S outside [S_min,S_max] is rejected exactly. No hidden epsilon widens the physical table domain.

exit_rule.pass: Freeze this mapping for C2B bounded face-table characterization and test a separately contracted steady-face representation without changing the physical closure.
exit_rule.fail: Fail-close the mapping. Do not fall back to runtime nonlinear theta-to-head inversion inside RossFast.

scope_guard: Coordinate conditioning only for h=[-10000,-1] cm. No claim for h>-1 cm, saturation switching, positive pressure head, timestep accuracy, groundwater coupling or production state layout.
